description: Search, create and update Linear issues, projects, initiatives, documents, milestones, labels, cycles and teams through your logged-in linear.app session in your current tab.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search and filter Linear issues. Supports text search, filtering by team, assignee, state, label, project, and more. Returns paginated results.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single Linear issue by its UUID or human-readable identifier (e.g. ENG-123).

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in Linear. Requires a team ID and title at minimum.

tools.name: update_issue
tools.description: Update an existing Linear issue. Only specified fields are changed; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: delete_issue
tools.description: Move a Linear issue to the trash. Trashed issues can be restored within 30 days.

tools.name: archive_issue
tools.description: Archive a Linear issue. Archived issues are hidden from default views but can be restored.

tools.name: batch_update_issues
tools.description: Apply the same update to multiple issues at once. All specified fields are applied to every issue in the batch. Maximum 25 issues per call.

tools.name: list_sub_issues
tools.description: List child/sub-issues of a parent Linear issue.

tools.name: list_issue_history
tools.description: List the change history (state changes, assignee changes, priority changes) for a Linear issue.

tools.name: list_issue_relations
tools.description: List relations (blocks, is blocked by, relates to, duplicate of) for a Linear issue.

tools.name: create_issue_relation
tools.description: Create a relation between two Linear issues (blocks, is blocked by, relates to, or duplicate of).

tools.name: delete_issue_relation
tools.description: Delete a relation between two Linear issues. Use list_issue_relations to find relation IDs.

tools.name: add_issue_label
tools.description: Add a label to an issue without removing existing labels. Unlike update_issue which replaces all labels, this appends.

tools.name: remove_issue_label
tools.description: Remove a label from an issue without affecting other labels. Unlike update_issue which replaces all labels, this removes only the specified one.

tools.name: add_issue_subscriber
tools.description: Subscribe a user to receive notifications for a Linear issue.

tools.name: remove_issue_subscriber
tools.description: Unsubscribe a user from notifications for a Linear issue.

tools.name: set_issue_cycle
tools.description: Assign an issue to a cycle (sprint). Use list_cycles to find cycle IDs. Pass an empty string to remove from the current cycle.

tools.name: move_issue_to_project
tools.description: Move an issue to a different project. Use list_projects to find project IDs. Pass an empty string to remove from the current project.

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.description: List attachments (linked PRs, documents, URLs) on a Linear issue.

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single attachment by its UUID.

tools.name: create_attachment
tools.description: Link a URL (PR, document, design file, etc.) to a Linear issue as an attachment.

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.description: Delete an attachment from a Linear issue.

tools.name: create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to an existing Linear issue.

tools.name: update_comment
tools.description: Update an existing comment on a Linear issue.

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment from a Linear issue.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments on a Linear issue, ordered by creation date.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List all projects in the Linear workspace. Supports pagination.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single Linear project by its UUID.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a new project in Linear.

tools.name: update_project
tools.description: Update an existing Linear project. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: list_project_labels
tools.description: List labels applied to a specific Linear project.

tools.name: list_project_updates
tools.description: List status updates (health reports) for a Linear project.

tools.name: create_project_update
tools.description: Post a status update (health report) on a Linear project.

tools.name: delete_project_update
tools.description: Delete a status update from a Linear project.

tools.name: list_milestones
tools.description: List milestones for a Linear project.

tools.name: get_milestone
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single project milestone by its UUID.

tools.name: create_milestone
tools.description: Create a new milestone in a Linear project.

tools.name: update_milestone
tools.description: Update an existing milestone in a Linear project. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: list_initiatives
tools.description: List initiatives in the Linear workspace, optionally filtered by status.

tools.name: get_initiative
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single Linear initiative by its UUID.

tools.name: create_initiative
tools.description: Create a new initiative in Linear.

tools.name: update_initiative
tools.description: Update an existing Linear initiative. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents in the Linear workspace, optionally filtered by project.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single Linear document by its UUID.

tools.name: create_document
tools.description: Create a new document in Linear, optionally associated with a project.

tools.name: update_document
tools.description: Update an existing Linear document. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List all teams in the Linear workspace that the current user can access.

tools.name: get_team
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single Linear team by its UUID.

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.description: List members of a specific Linear team.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List all users in the Linear organization. Use this to find user IDs for assigning issues.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single Linear user by their UUID.

tools.name: get_viewer
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's profile information.

tools.name: list_workflow_states
tools.description: List all workflow states for a team. Use this to find state IDs for filtering issues or updating issue state.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.description: List all issue labels in the Linear workspace. Use this to find label IDs for creating or filtering issues.

tools.name: create_label
tools.description: Create a new issue label in Linear.

tools.name: update_label
tools.description: Update an existing Linear issue label. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: delete_label
tools.description: Delete a Linear issue label. Labels will be removed from all issues that use them.

tools.name: list_cycles
tools.description: List cycles (sprints) for a team. Use this to find cycle IDs for creating or filtering issues.

tools.name: get_cycle
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single cycle (sprint) by its UUID.
